mapper.sql: r.role_id, r.role_cd, r.role_nm, r.description, (SELECT count(*) FROM tb_admin_role ar WHERE ar.role_id = r.role_id)::int AS admin_cnt, r.system_yn, r.use_yn, ra.admin_nm AS reg_nm, r.reg_dt, ma.admin_nm AS mod_nm, r.mod_dt
FROM tb_role r LEFT JOIN tb_admin ra ON ra.admin_id = r.reg_id LEFT JOIN tb_admin ma ON ma.admin_id = r.mod_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
(r.role_cd ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR r.role_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND r.use_yn = #{useYn}
ORDER BY r.role_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_role WHERE role_cd = #{roleCd})
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_admin_role WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND role_id = #{roleId})
INSERT INTO tb_role (role_cd, role_nm, description, use_yn, system_yn, reg_id, mod_id) VALUES (#{roleCd}, #{roleNm}, #{description}, #{useYn}, 'N', #{regId}, #{regId}) RETURNING role_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_role SET role_nm = #{roleNm}, description = #{description}, use_yn = #{useYn}, mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)
UPDATE tb_role SET mod_id = #{modId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE role_id = #{roleId} AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)
mapper.select: SELECT menu_id, parent_menu_id, menu_cd, menu_nm, menu_type_cd, depth, use_yn FROM tb_menu ORDER BY depth, sort_ord, menu_id
mapper.sql: ORDER BY p.menu_id, CASE p.action_cd WHEN 'READ' THEN 1 WHEN 'CREATE' THEN 2 WHEN 'UPDATE' THEN 3 WHEN 'DELETE' THEN 4 WHEN 'EXCEL' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
mapper.select: SELECT p.perm_id, p.menu_id, m.menu_cd, m.menu_nm, p.action_cd FROM tb_permission p JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_id = p.menu_id

SELECT p.perm_id, p.menu_id, m.menu_cd, m.menu_nm, p.action_cd FROM tb_role_permission rp JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_id = rp.perm_id JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_id = p.menu_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_role_permission (role_id, perm_id, reg_id) VALUES (#{roleId}, #{id}, #{regId}) ON CONFLICT (role_id, perm_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT a.admin_id, a.login_id, a.admin_nm, a.dept_nm, a.status_cd, c.code_nm AS status_nm, ar.reg_dt AS granted_dt FROM tb_admin_role ar JOIN tb_admin a ON a.admin_id = ar.admin_id LEFT JOIN tb_code c ON c.group_cd = 'ADMIN_STATUS' AND c.code = a.status_cd WHERE ar.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY ar.reg_dt, a.admin_id
